Original character reference sheet (model sheet) for a manga. Shonen manga, black and white: bold confident ink lines, heavy solid blacks, high-contrast screentone, energetic poses, impact frames for big moments. Black ink and grey screentone only, no colour.
Character: Rin Asagiri.
Appearance: short black hair, sharp grey eyes, slim courier build.
Default outfit: Courier: hooded rain cape over a messenger jacket, satchel strap.
Personality to show through posture and expressions: steadfast and quick to act.
Layout: this one character only, drawn as a full-body turnaround (front, three-quarter, side and back views) standing in a relaxed neutral pose and evenly spaced in a row, plus a row of head close-ups with neutral, happy, angry and surprised expressions. Identical proportions, hairstyle, costume and accessories in every view. Plain opaque white background, no scenery, no props.
Rules: original artwork only; no text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, signatures, watermarks or logos; no panel borders, frames or gutters; one single image, not a comic page; non-explicit, no nudity, no gore.
Avoid: text, letters, words, numbers, speech bubbles, word balloons, captions, sound effect lettering, signature, watermark, logo, panel borders, frames, gutters, multiple panels, comic page layout, nudity, gore, blurry, low quality, deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, labels, arrows, colour swatches, background scenery, props, multiple different characters, colour, color
